annotations.title: Check a site once: what search engines and agents find

description: Check a site once: what search engines and agents find. Reads a domain's robots.txt, homepage, sitemap, 404 page and the files agents look for, scores it A to F, and keeps the report at /check/<domain> (or only at its own address, with private). Needs no key. (POST /check)

domain.description: The site's domain or address: example.com

private.description: Keep the report off the domain's page: it's only at its own address. Default false
